[2026-09-02T22:36:47.793Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-09-02T22:36:47.794Z] [arbiter] The traders were right. Aetherkin. Some kneel to them; some burn them where they stand.
[2026-09-02T22:36:47.794Z] [world] In life it was a bell-ringer, shoulders rounded from a rope pulled ten thousand times — you find yourself wanting to know their name, and knowing you never will. The silt let go of them all at once, and they came up clawing at the light.
[2026-09-02T22:36:47.794Z] [world] It doesn't lunge. It cringes back, arms up over its face — remembering, dimly, that living things once meant harm. It will only fight if you make it.
[2026-09-02T22:36:47.795Z] [world] You walk west through open silt. The compass tells you The Buried Cities lies further west — 5 tiles, about 13 hours of travel.
[2026-09-02T22:36:47.795Z] [world] It sits where it sat. Patient is the wrong word — it simply does not move.
